near_synonyms.difference: 多 alone after a noun phrase states the quantity is large (人很多); 很多 goes before the noun (很多人)

多.meaning: many; much; more than the right amount (人很多; 多了两个)

examples.hanzi: 周末商场里人很多。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò shāngchǎng lǐ rén hěn duō.
examples.english: There were a lot of people in the mall on the weekend.

examples.hanzi: 这次作业太多了。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì zuòyè tài duō le.
examples.english: This time there was way too much homework.

多.meaning: more (used before a verb or measure phrase: 多吃一点儿; 请多说一遍)

examples.hanzi: 你应该多吃点儿水果。
examples.pinyin: nǐ yīnggāi duō chī diǎnr shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: You should eat more fruit.

多.meaning: to what degree; how (in 有多… questions: 你家离学校有多远?)

examples.hanzi: 你家离学校有多远？
examples.pinyin: nǐ jiā lí xuéxiào yǒu duō yuǎn?
examples.english: How far is your home from the school?

多.meaning: to exceed by (a margin): 多花了两块钱

examples.hanzi: 我多花了两个小时才找到那儿。
examples.pinyin: wǒ duō huā le liǎng gè xiǎoshí cái zhǎodào nàr.
examples.english: It took me two extra hours to find the place.

给.meaning: to give; to hand over (给我你的电话号码)

examples.hanzi: 请给我一杯水。
examples.pinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: Please give me a glass of water.

给.meaning: to; for (marks the receiver before the verb: 给他打电话; 我给你买了一个蛋糕)

examples.hanzi: 晚上我给妈妈打了个电话。
examples.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒ gěi māma dǎ le ge diànhuà.
examples.english: In the evening I gave Mom a call.

examples.hanzi: 公司每年给员工两次培训机会。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī měi nián jǐ yuángōng liǎng cì péixùn jīhuì.
examples.english: The company provides employees two training opportunities a year.

near_synonyms.difference: 不错 is milder praise than 好 — 'better than expected', often informal

examples.hanzi: 这家饭馆的菜很好。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài hěn hǎo.
examples.english: The food at this restaurant is very good.

好.meaning: very; so (before adjectives: 好冷啊; 好多人)

examples.hanzi: 今天好冷啊！
examples.pinyin: jīntiān hǎo lěng a!
examples.english: It's so cold today!

好.meaning: to like; to be fond of (as in 爱好, 好学)

examples.hanzi: 他是个好学的人，每天都读书。
examples.pinyin: tā shì ge hào xué de rén, měi tiān dōu dú shū.
examples.english: He's a person who loves learning; he reads every day.

那.meaning: that (also read nèi before measure words; base reading nà)

examples.hanzi: 那本书是我的。
examples.pinyin: nà běn shū shì wǒ de.
examples.english: That book is mine.

那.meaning: then; in that case (那你怎么办?)

examples.hanzi: 那我们明天再谈吧。
examples.pinyin: nà wǒmen míngtiān zài tán ba.
examples.english: Then let's talk again tomorrow.

啊.meaning: sentence-final particle: exclamation, emphasis, or softening the tone (真漂亮啊!; 你说什么啊?)

examples.hanzi: 这儿的花真漂亮啊！
examples.pinyin: zhèr de huā zhēn piàoliang a!
examples.english: The flowers here are so beautiful!

examples.hanzi: 啊，我忘了带钥匙！
examples.pinyin: a, wǒ wàng le dài yàoshi!
examples.english: Ah, I forgot to bring my keys!

爱好.meaning: hobby; interest; to love, to be keen on (他的爱好是游泳)

examples.hanzi: 我最大的爱好是旅游。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zuì dà de àihào shì lǚyóu.
examples.english: My biggest hobby is traveling.

examples.hanzi: 她穿了一件白色的衬衫。
examples.pinyin: tā chuān le yī jiàn báisè de chènshān.
examples.english: She wore a white shirt.

班.meaning: class; shift (上课, 上班; measure word 个)

examples.hanzi: 我们班有二十个学生。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen bān yǒu èrshí ge xuéshēng.
examples.english: There are twenty students in our class.

班.meaning: for scheduled runs of buses, trains, flights: 这班公交车, 一班飞机

examples.hanzi: 我每天坐这班公交车回家。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zuò zhè bān gōngjiāochē huí jiā.
examples.english: I take this bus home every day.

near_synonyms.difference: 帮忙 is intransitive and separable — you 帮忙 or 帮某人一个忙, but not 帮忙某人; 帮 takes a direct object (帮妈妈)

帮.meaning: to help; to assist (帮妈妈做饭)

examples.hanzi: 他常帮妈妈做晚饭。
examples.pinyin: tā cháng bāng māma zuò wǎnfàn.
examples.english: He often helps his mom make dinner.

帮忙.meaning: to help; to do a favor (separable 离合词: 帮了我一个大忙)

examples.hanzi: 有什么需要帮忙的，就告诉我。
examples.pinyin: yǒu shénme xūyào bāngmáng de, jiù gàosu wǒ.
examples.english: If there's anything you need help with, just tell me.

包.meaning: bag; sack; pouch (书包, 钱包; measure word 个)

examples.hanzi: 我的包放在教室里了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de bāo fàng zài jiàoshì lǐ le.
examples.english: I left my bag in the classroom.

包.meaning: to wrap; to pack (把书包起来)

examples.hanzi: 她用纸把礼物包了起来。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng zhǐ bǎ lǐwù bāo le qǐlái.
examples.english: She wrapped the present with paper.

examples.hanzi: 请买五个本子，上课要用。
examples.pinyin: qǐng mǎi wǔ ge běnzi, shàngkè yào yòng.
examples.english: Please buy five notebooks; we'll use them in class.

比.meaning: than (comparison: A比B高; 今天比昨天冷)

examples.hanzi: 今天比昨天热多了。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān bǐ zuótiān rè duō le.
examples.english: Today is much hotter than yesterday.

笔.meaning: pen; pencil; writing brush (measure word 支)

examples.hanzi: 这支笔是你借我的吗？
examples.pinyin: zhè zhī bǐ shì nǐ jiè wǒ de ma?
examples.english: Is this the pen you lent me?

笔.meaning: for sums of money: 一笔钱

examples.hanzi: 这项工作需要一笔钱。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng gōngzuò xūyào yī bǐ qián.
examples.english: This project requires a sum of money.

near_synonyms.difference: 不要 is the full form, more formal or emphatic; 别 is the everyday short form

别1.meaning: don't (imperative negative: 别走了!; 别说话)

examples.hanzi: 别担心，我没事。
examples.pinyin: bié dānxīn, wǒ méi shì.
examples.english: Don't worry, I'm fine.

不好意思.meaning: excuse me; sorry (mild apology or before a request)

examples.hanzi: 不好意思，请再说一遍。
examples.pinyin: bù hǎoyìsi, qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.
examples.english: Sorry, could you say that again?

不好意思.meaning: embarrassed; shy; to feel awkward (让他很不好意思)

examples.hanzi: 他夸我的时候，我觉得很不好意思。
examples.pinyin: tā kuā wǒ de shíhou, wǒ juéde hěn bù hǎoyìsi.
examples.english: When he complimented me I felt quite embarrassed.

examples.hanzi: 这家酒店的房间不错，也不贵。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de fángjiān bùcuò, yě bù guì.
examples.english: The rooms at this hotel are pretty good, and not expensive either.

examples.hanzi: 北京的冬天很长。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng de dōngtiān hěn cháng.
examples.english: Winters in Beijing are very long.

长.meaning: to grow; to grow up (孩子长大了; 长得像妈妈)

examples.hanzi: 孩子们长得真快。
examples.pinyin: háizimen zhǎng de zhēn kuài.
examples.english: The kids are growing up so fast.

examples.hanzi: 我在车站等了你半个小时。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài chēzhàn děng le nǐ bàn gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: I waited for you at the station for half an hour.

出.meaning: to go out; to come out; to leave (出门, 出去; 他从房间里出来了)

examples.hanzi: 他刚从办公室出来。
examples.pinyin: tā gāng cóng bàngōngshì chūlái.
examples.english: He just came out of the office.

出.meaning: to produce; to put forth (出汗, 出力, 出主意)

examples.hanzi: 天太热了，我一直出汗。
examples.pinyin: tiān tài rè le, wǒ yìzhí chū hàn.
examples.english: It's so hot, I keep sweating.

examples.hanzi: 这张床很舒服。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng chuáng hěn shūfu.
examples.english: This bed is very comfortable.

出国.meaning: to go abroad (to leave one's country, esp. to study or travel)

examples.hanzi: 他明年想出国学习。
examples.pinyin: tā míngnián xiǎng chūguó xuéxí.
examples.english: He wants to go abroad to study next year.

出来.meaning: to come out; also a directional complement after a verb (从教室里出来; 我看出来了)

examples.hanzi: 老师让我们一个一个地出来。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī ràng wǒmen yī ge yī ge de chūlái.
examples.english: The teacher had us come out one by one.

出门.meaning: to go out; to leave the house

examples.hanzi: 爸爸出门的时候天还没亮。
examples.pinyin: bàba chūmén de shíhou tiān hái méi liàng.
examples.english: It wasn't light yet when Dad left the house.

出去.meaning: to go out (away from the speaker); also a directional complement (我们出去吃饭吧)

examples.hanzi: 周末我们出去看电影吧。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò wǒmen chūqù kàn diànyǐng ba.
examples.english: Let's go out and see a movie this weekend.

examples.hanzi: 课文里的生词我都记住了。
examples.pinyin: kèwén lǐ de shēngcí wǒ dōu jì zhù le.
examples.english: I've memorized all the new words in the text.

examples.hanzi: 这首歌的词写得真好。
examples.pinyin: zhè shǒu gē de cí xiě de zhēn hǎo.
examples.english: The lyrics of this song are beautifully written.

次.meaning: for occurrences of events: 一次, 第一次, 这次会议

examples.hanzi: 这是我第一次来中国。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Zhōngguó.
examples.english: This is my first time in China.

从.meaning: from (starting point in time or space: 从八点到十点; 从家到学校)

examples.hanzi: 从家到学校要走二十分钟。
examples.pinyin: cóng jiā dào xuéxiào yào zǒu èrshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: It takes twenty minutes to walk from home to school.

从小.meaning: from childhood; since one was young (他从小就会游泳)

examples.hanzi: 他从小就喜欢画画儿。
examples.pinyin: tā cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuan huà huàr.
examples.english: He has loved drawing since he was little.

examples.hanzi: 对不起，我拿错了你的包。
examples.pinyin: duìbuqǐ, wǒ ná cuò le nǐ de bāo.
examples.english: Sorry, I took your bag by mistake.

错.meaning: mistake; fault (认错了人; 是我的错)

examples.hanzi: 这不是我的错。
examples.pinyin: zhè bù shì wǒ de cuò.
examples.english: This isn't my fault.

打1.meaning: to hit; to strike (他打了我一下)

examples.hanzi: 他生气地打了一下桌子。
examples.pinyin: tā shēngqì de dǎ le yī xià zhuōzi.
examples.english: He angrily hit the table.

打1.meaning: to make (a phone call): 打电话

examples.hanzi: 我到家以后给你打电话。
examples.pinyin: wǒ dào jiā yǐhòu gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: I'll call you after I get home.

打1.meaning: to play (a ball game; mahjong): 打篮球, 打乒乓球

examples.hanzi: 每到周末我们都去打篮球。
examples.pinyin: měi dào zhōumò wǒmen dōu qù dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: Every weekend we all go play basketball.

打1.meaning: to fetch/buy (water, a ticket); to take (a taxi): 打水, 打车

examples.hanzi: 他去楼下打了一瓶水。
examples.pinyin: tā qù lóuxià dǎ le yī píng shuǐ.
examples.english: He went downstairs and fetched a bottle of water.

examples.hanzi: 这份报告你得打出来。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn bàogào nǐ děi dǎ chūlái.
examples.english: You need to type this report out.

打车.meaning: to take/hail a taxi (also 打的)

examples.hanzi: 太晚了，我们打车回家吧。
examples.pinyin: tài wǎn le, wǒmen dǎchē huí jiā ba.
examples.english: It's too late; let's take a taxi home.

打开.meaning: to open; to turn on (打开门, 打开电视)

examples.hanzi: 请打开书，看第五页。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dǎkāi shū, kàn dì wǔ yè.
examples.english: Please open your books and look at page five.

但.meaning: but; yet (slightly more written/abrupt than 但是)

examples.hanzi: 我很累，但我还想再看一会儿电视。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hěn lèi, dàn wǒ hái xiǎng zài kàn yīhuìr diànshì.
examples.english: I'm tired, but I still want to watch TV a while longer.

near_synonyms.difference: 但 is shorter and slightly more written; 但是 is the neutral spoken and written choice

examples.hanzi: 这家饭馆很小，但是菜很好吃。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā fànguǎn hěn xiǎo, dànshì cài hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant is small, but the food is great.

得.meaning: structural particle after a verb, marking a degree or manner complement (跑得快; 说得很好)

examples.hanzi: 妹妹跑得比我快。
examples.pinyin: mèimei pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài.
examples.english: My little sister runs faster than me.

near_synonyms.difference: 要 can mean simple future or wanting; 得 (děi) specifically means obligation 'have to' from circumstance

得.meaning: to have to; must (我得走了)

examples.hanzi: 太晚了，我得回家了。
examples.pinyin: tài wǎn le, wǒ děi huí jiā le.
examples.english: It's too late — I have to go home.

得.meaning: to get; to obtain (a result or score): 得了一百分, 得第一名

examples.hanzi: 他考了三次，终于得了第一名。
examples.pinyin: tā kǎo le sān cì, zhōngyú dé le dì yī míng.
examples.english: He took the test three times and finally got first place.

地.meaning: ground; earth; land (地上, 菜地; measure word 块)

examples.hanzi: 猫在地上睡觉。
examples.pinyin: māo zài dì shang shuìjiào.
examples.english: The cat is sleeping on the floor.

地.meaning: adverbial marker before a verb: 慢慢地走, 高兴地说

examples.hanzi: 他慢慢地站了起来。
examples.pinyin: tā mànmàn de zhàn le qǐlái.
examples.english: He slowly stood up.

等1.meaning: to wait; to wait for (等一下; 等我一会儿)

examples.hanzi: 你等我十分钟，好吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ děng wǒ shí fēnzhōng, hǎo ma?
examples.english: Wait for me ten minutes, OK?

点2.meaning: to order (food or drinks): 点菜, 点一杯咖啡

examples.hanzi: 服务员，我们要点菜。
examples.pinyin: fúwùyuán, wǒmen yào diǎn cài.
examples.english: Waiter, we'd like to order.

点2.meaning: dot; point; drop (标点; 雨点)

examples.hanzi: 雨点打在窗户上。
examples.pinyin: yǔdiǎn dǎ zài chuānghu shang.
examples.english: Raindrops hit the window.

examples.hanzi: 坐地铁去比坐公交车快。
examples.pinyin: zuò dìtiě qù bǐ zuò gōngjiāochē kuài.
examples.english: Going by subway is faster than by bus.

动.meaning: to move (别动!; 他动了一下)

examples.hanzi: 别动，我给你拍张照片。
examples.pinyin: bié dòng, wǒ gěi nǐ pāi zhāng zhàopiàn.
examples.english: Don't move — I'll take a photo of you.

懂.meaning: to understand (我懂了; 你懂汉语吗?)

examples.hanzi: 老师说慢一点儿，我就懂了。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī shuō màn yīdiǎnr, wǒ jiù dǒng le.
examples.english: When the teacher speaks more slowly, I understand.

examples.hanzi: 学校旁边新开了一家饭馆。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào pángbiān xīn kāi le yī jiā fànguǎn.
examples.english: A new restaurant opened next to the school.

飞.meaning: to fly (飞机飞得很高; 从北京飞到上海)

examples.hanzi: 飞机飞得很高，我看不清。
examples.pinyin: fēijī fēi de hěn gāo, wǒ kàn bu qīng.
examples.english: The plane flew so high I couldn't see it clearly.

高.meaning: tall; high (个子高, 价格高)

examples.hanzi: 他弟弟比他高三厘米。
examples.pinyin: tā dìdi bǐ tā gāo sān límǐ.
examples.english: His younger brother is three centimeters taller than him.

告诉.meaning: to tell (takes double objects: 请告诉我你的名字)

examples.hanzi: 请告诉我你的电子邮件地址。
examples.pinyin: qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ de diànzǐ yóujiàn dìzhǐ.
examples.english: Please tell me your email address.

examples.hanzi: 姐姐明年上高中。
examples.pinyin: jiějie míngnián shàng gāozhōng.
examples.english: My older sister starts high school next year.

near_synonyms.difference: 和 mainly joins nouns; 跟 as a preposition also introduces the person you act with or toward (我跟你商量)

跟.meaning: with (introduces companion or object of action: 跟朋友一起去; 我跟你说)

examples.hanzi: 我想跟你一起去买东西。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yīqǐ qù mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: I'd like to go shopping with you.

跟.meaning: and (joining nouns, informal: 我跟他都喜欢打球)

examples.hanzi: 我跟他都喜欢吃辣的。
examples.pinyin: wǒ gēn tā dōu xǐhuan chī là de.
examples.english: Both he and I like spicy food.

examples.hanzi: 他个子高，篮球打得很好。
examples.pinyin: tā gèzi gāo, lánqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He's tall and plays basketball well.

公交车.meaning: bus (坐公交车; also 公共汽车)

examples.hanzi: 我坐公交车上班要四十分钟。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zuò gōngjiāochē shàngbān yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: It takes me forty minutes to get to work by bus.

过.meaning: to cross; to pass through (过马路, 过桥)

examples.hanzi: 过马路以前要先看左右。
examples.pinyin: guò mǎlù yǐqián yào xiān kàn zuǒyòu.
examples.english: Look left and right before crossing the road.

过.meaning: to spend (time); to celebrate (a festival): 过生日, 过年, 过周末

examples.hanzi: 我们在奶奶家过了春节。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zài nǎinai jiā guò le Chūnjié.
examples.english: We spent Spring Festival at Grandma's house.

near_synonyms.difference: 了 marks an action as completed; 过 marks experience — having done it at least once before

过.meaning: experiential aspect particle after a verb, neutral tone: 我去过中国; 你吃过北京烤鸭吗?

examples.hanzi: 你吃过北京烤鸭吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ chī guo Běijīng kǎoyā ma?
examples.english: Have you ever eaten Beijing roast duck?

过来.meaning: to come over (toward the speaker); also a directional complement (你过来一下; 他走过来)

examples.hanzi: 请你过来一下，帮我看这个。
examples.pinyin: qǐng nǐ guòlái yīxià, bāng wǒ kàn zhège.
examples.english: Please come over a moment and help me look at this.

过年.meaning: to celebrate the New Year (esp. the Spring Festival)

examples.hanzi: 过年的时候孩子们能拿到红包。
examples.pinyin: guònián de shíhou háizimen néng ná dào hóngbāo.
examples.english: Kids get red envelopes at New Year time.

过去1.meaning: the past; former times (在过去, 过去的事)

examples.hanzi: 过去的事就别再想了。
examples.pinyin: guòqu de shì jiù bié zài xiǎng le.
examples.english: Don't keep thinking about things in the past.

过去1.meaning: to go over (away from the speaker); directional complement (他跑过去了)

examples.hanzi: 他慢慢走了过去。
examples.pinyin: tā mànmàn zǒu le guòqù.
examples.english: He slowly walked over.

near_synonyms.difference: 还是 presents alternatives in a question (A还是B?); 或者 joins alternatives in a statement (周末或者去看电影，或者去打球)

还是.meaning: or (in alternative questions: 你喝茶还是咖啡?; 去还是不去?)

examples.hanzi: 你周末想打球还是想游泳？
examples.pinyin: nǐ zhōumò xiǎng dǎqiú háishì xiǎng yóuyǒng?
examples.english: Do you want to play ball or swim this weekend?

near_synonyms.difference: alone 还 carries the same 'still' meaning; 还是 is slightly more emphatic and common before a negative or in advice

还是.meaning: still; all the same (现在还是很热; 他还是没来)

examples.hanzi: 都十点了，他还是没回电话。
examples.pinyin: dōu shí diǎn le, tā háishì méi huí diànhuà.
examples.english: It's already ten and he still hasn't returned the call.

examples.hanzi: 他穿着黑色的鞋。
examples.pinyin: tā chuān zhe hēisè de xié.
examples.english: He's wearing black shoes.

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢在红茶里放点儿糖。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan zài hóngchá lǐ fàng diǎnr táng.
examples.english: I like to put a little sugar in my black tea.

examples.hanzi: 她买了一辆红色的小汽车。
examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī liàng hóngsè de xiǎo qìchē.
examples.english: She bought a red car.

后面.meaning: back; behind; rear (location: 教室后面, 楼后面)

examples.hanzi: 教室后面有一块黑板吗？不，黑板在前面。
examples.pinyin: jiàoshì hòumian yǒu yī kuài hēibǎn ma? bù, hēibǎn zài qiánmian.
examples.english: Is there a blackboard at the back of the classroom? No, it's at the front.

后面.meaning: later; afterwards (后面的课, 后面几页)

examples.hanzi: 后面的几道题比较难。
examples.pinyin: hòumian de jǐ dào tí bǐjiào nán.
examples.english: The questions further on are rather hard.

画.meaning: to draw; to paint (画一个圆圈)

examples.hanzi: 他在纸上画了一只小鸟。
examples.pinyin: tā zài zhǐ shang huà le yī zhī xiǎoniǎo.
examples.english: He drew a little bird on the paper.

画.meaning: drawing; painting; picture (measure word 张/幅)

examples.hanzi: 墙上挂了一张山水画。
examples.pinyin: qiáng shang guà le yī zhāng shānshuǐhuà.
examples.english: A landscape painting hangs on the wall.

examples.hanzi: 公园里的花都开了。
examples.pinyin: gōngyuán lǐ de huā dōu kāi le.
examples.english: The flowers in the park have all bloomed.

花2.meaning: to spend (money or time): 花了五百块, 花了两个小时

examples.hanzi: 这本书我花了八十块钱。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū wǒ huā le bāshí kuài qián.
examples.english: This book cost me eighty yuan.

坏.meaning: bad; broken; spoiled (电视坏了; 坏消息)

examples.hanzi: 我的手机坏了，打不开。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de shǒujī huài le, dǎ bu kāi.
examples.english: My phone is broken and won't turn on.

坏.meaning: bad (of people or behavior); naughty (坏人, 坏习惯)

examples.hanzi: 拿别人的东西是不好的习惯，不是坏孩子才这样做。
examples.pinyin: ná biérén de dōngxi shì bù hǎo de xíguàn, bù shì huài háizi cái zhèyàng zuò.
examples.english: Taking other people's things is a bad habit — it isn't only bad kids who do that.

回来.meaning: to come back (toward the speaker); directional complement (爸爸回来了; 把书拿回来)

examples.hanzi: 爸爸下班回来就会修它。
examples.pinyin: bàba xiàbān huílai jiù huì xiū tā.
examples.english: Dad will fix it as soon as he comes home from work.

回去.meaning: to go back (away from the speaker); directional complement (我们回去吧; 把书送回去)

examples.hanzi: 太晚了，我们回去吧。
examples.pinyin: tài wǎn le, wǒmen huíqu ba.
examples.english: It's too late; let's head back.

间.meaning: for rooms: 一间教室, 一间卧室

examples.hanzi: 这层楼有四间教室。
examples.pinyin: zhè céng lóu yǒu sì jiān jiàoshì.
examples.english: There are four classrooms on this floor.

教.meaning: to teach (教汉语, 教我们英语)

examples.hanzi: 王老师教我们汉语。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen Hànyǔ.
examples.english: Teacher Wang teaches us Chinese.

教.meaning: to make sb do (使/让, in 使令 compounds like 教人佩服)

examples.hanzi: 那里的风景美得教人难忘。
examples.pinyin: nàlǐ de fēngjǐng měi de jiào rén nánwàng.
examples.english: The scenery there is so beautiful it's unforgettable.

examples.hanzi: 下课后教室里没有人。
examples.pinyin: xià kè hòu jiàoshì lǐ méi yǒu rén.
examples.english: There was no one in the classroom after class.

examples.hanzi: 从机场到市中心坐地铁最方便。
examples.pinyin: cóng jīchǎng dào shì zhōngxīn zuò dìtiě zuì fāngbiàn.
examples.english: The subway is the easiest way from the airport to downtown.

记得.meaning: to remember (记得告诉我; 你记得他的名字吗? negative is 不记得)

examples.hanzi: 你还记得我们第一次见面吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ hái jìde wǒmen dì yī cì jiànmiàn ma?
examples.english: Do you still remember the first time we met?

介绍.meaning: to introduce; introduction (介绍一个朋友给我; 自我介绍)

examples.hanzi: 我来介绍一下，这是我哥哥。
examples.pinyin: wǒ lái jièshào yīxià, zhè shì wǒ gēge.
examples.english: Let me introduce — this is my older brother.

进.meaning: to enter; to go in (走进教室; 请进!)

examples.hanzi: 他从后门进了教室。
examples.pinyin: tā cóng hòumén jìn le jiàoshì.
examples.english: He entered the classroom through the back door.

近.meaning: near; close (in distance; 我家离学校很近)

examples.hanzi: 我家离公司很近，走路十分钟。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiā lí gōngsī hěn jìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: My home is close to the office — ten minutes on foot.

near_synonyms.difference: 经常 means frequently, more than half the time; 有时候 means occasionally, some of the time

examples.hanzi: 他经常在图书馆学习。
examples.pinyin: tā jīngcháng zài túshūguǎn xuéxí.
examples.english: He often studies in the library.

进来.meaning: to come in (toward the speaker); directional complement (请进来; 他跑了进来)

examples.hanzi: 外面冷，快进来吧！
examples.pinyin: wàimian lěng, kuài jìnlai ba!
examples.english: It's cold outside — come in quickly!

进去.meaning: to go in (away from the speaker); directional complement (他走进去了)

examples.hanzi: 门开了，他走了进去。
examples.pinyin: mén kāi le, tā zǒu le jìnqù.
examples.english: The door opened and he went in.

examples.hanzi: 我买了一张去上海的机票。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī zhāng qù Shànghǎi de jīpiào.
examples.english: I bought a plane ticket to Shanghai.

就.meaning: right away; as early as (我马上就来; 他七点就到了)

examples.hanzi: 你等一下，我马上就来。
examples.pinyin: nǐ děng yīxià, wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái.
examples.english: Wait a moment, I'll be right there.

就.meaning: only; just (他就一个朋友; 就吃了两块)

examples.hanzi: 他就懂汉语，不懂英语。
examples.pinyin: tā jiù dǒng Hànyǔ, bù dǒng Yīngyǔ.
examples.english: He only understands Chinese, not English.

就.meaning: then (linking two clauses: 如果…就…; 你来, 我就走)

examples.hanzi: 你要是有问题，就问我。
examples.pinyin: nǐ yàoshi yǒu wèntí, jiù wèn wǒ.
examples.english: If you have a question, just ask me.

就.meaning: emphasis before a predicate, 'precisely/exactly': 这就是我的书; 我就是没看见

examples.hanzi: 这就是我们要找的房子。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiù shì wǒmen yào zhǎo de fángzi.
examples.english: This is exactly the house we were looking for.

examples.hanzi: 我们在网上订了这家酒店。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zài wǎngshang dìng le zhè jiā jiǔdiàn.
examples.english: We booked this hotel online.

examples.hanzi: 早上我喝了一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: zǎoshang wǒ hē le yī bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: I had a cup of coffee this morning.

开始.meaning: to begin; to start; beginning (开始上课; 从…开始)

examples.hanzi: 电影七点开始，我们快走吧。
examples.pinyin: diànyǐng qī diǎn kāishǐ, wǒmen kuài zǒu ba.
examples.english: The movie starts at seven — let's hurry.

开学.meaning: (of a new school term) to begin; school starts (九月一号开学)

examples.hanzi: 九月一号开学，同学们都很高兴。
examples.pinyin: jiǔyuè yī hào kāixué, tóngxuémen dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.english: School starts September 1st and the students are all happy.

考.meaning: to give/set an exam (of a teacher: 老师考我们生词)

examples.hanzi: 明天老师要考我们生词。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān lǎoshī yào kǎo wǒmen shēngcí.
examples.english: Tomorrow the teacher will test us on the new words.

考.meaning: to take an exam/test in (考汉语, 考大学)

examples.hanzi: 他下个月要考驾照。
examples.pinyin: tā xià ge yuè yào kǎo jiàzhào.
examples.english: He's taking the driving test next month.

考试.meaning: to take an examination; exam, test (明天考数学; 期末考试)

examples.hanzi: 这次考试不太难。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì kǎoshì bù tài nán.
examples.english: This exam wasn't too hard.

可能.meaning: may; might; possibly (明天可能下雨; 他可能不来了)

examples.hanzi: 明天可能下雨，带上伞吧。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān kěnéng xià yǔ, dài shàng sǎn ba.
examples.english: It may rain tomorrow — bring an umbrella.

examples.hanzi: 他没来上课，有两种可能。
examples.pinyin: tā méi lái shàngkè, yǒu liǎng zhǒng kěnéng.
examples.english: He didn't come to class; there are two possibilities.

examples.hanzi: 他说汉语说得真快。
examples.pinyin: tā shuō Hànyǔ shuō de zhēn kuài.
examples.english: He speaks Chinese really fast.

快.meaning: soon; before long (天快黑了; 他快回来了)

examples.hanzi: 火车快到站了，我们准备一下。
examples.pinyin: huǒchē kuài dào zhàn le, wǒmen zhǔnbèi yīxià.
examples.english: The train is about to arrive — let's get ready.

快.meaning: at once; hurriedly (快走!; 快去快回)

examples.hanzi: 快走，电影就要开始了！
examples.pinyin: kuài zǒu, diànyǐng jiù yào kāishǐ le!
examples.english: Hurry — the movie's about to start!

快乐.meaning: happy; joyful (生日快乐!; 他们过得很快乐)

examples.hanzi: 祝你生日快乐！
examples.pinyin: zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
examples.english: Happy birthday to you!

near_synonyms.difference: 快 alone before a verb also means 'about to' (快到了); 快要 is slightly more explicit and never takes degree adverbs

快要.meaning: about to; on the verge of (火车快要开了)

examples.hanzi: 飞机快要起飞了，请关掉手机。
examples.pinyin: fēijī kuàiyào qǐfēi le, qǐng guāndiào shǒujī.
examples.english: The plane is about to take off; please turn off your phone.

examples.hanzi: 这条裤子太长了，有短一点儿的吗？
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo kùzi tài cháng le, yǒu duǎn yīdiǎnr de ma?
examples.english: These pants are too long — do you have shorter ones?

examples.hanzi: 男孩子们在操场上打篮球。
examples.pinyin: nánháizimen zài cāochǎng shang dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: The boys are playing basketball on the sports field.

累.meaning: tired; fatigued (走了一天, 我太累了)

examples.hanzi: 跑完步我累极了。
examples.pinyin: pǎo wán bù wǒ lèi jí le.
examples.english: I was exhausted after finishing my run.

离.meaning: away from (distance): 离学校很远; 离家五百米

examples.hanzi: 学校离我家有两公里。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào lí wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng gōnglǐ.
examples.english: The school is two kilometers from my home.

里面.meaning: inside; interior (房间里面; 里面有很多人)

examples.hanzi: 箱子里面的衣服都是新的。
examples.pinyin: xiāngzi lǐmiàn de yīfu dōu shì xīn de.
examples.english: The clothes inside the box are all new.

楼.meaning: building with more than one floor; floor; storey (教学楼, 二楼)

examples.hanzi: 我们家住在三楼。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen jiā zhù zài sān lóu.
examples.english: Our family lives on the third floor.

楼.meaning: used in floor numbering: 一楼, 二楼, 三楼

examples.hanzi: 他们的办公室在二楼。
examples.pinyin: tāmen de bàngōngshì zài èr lóu.
examples.english: Their office is on the second floor.

路.meaning: road; way; route (这条路; 问路; measure word 条)

examples.hanzi: 请问，去车站的路怎么走？
examples.pinyin: qǐngwèn, qù chēzhàn de lù zěnme zǒu?
examples.english: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

路.meaning: journey; distance covered (走了一天的路)

examples.hanzi: 回老家要看爷爷奶奶，这一路我坐了十个小时的火车。
examples.pinyin: huí lǎojiā yào kàn yéye nǎinai, zhè yī lù wǒ zuò le shí ge xiǎoshí de huǒchē.
examples.english: Going home to see Grandpa and Grandma, the journey took ten hours by train.

examples.hanzi: 来中国以后我爱上了绿茶。
examples.pinyin: lái Zhōngguó yǐhòu wǒ ài shàng le lǜchá.
examples.english: After coming to China I fell in love with green tea.

examples.hanzi: 春天树都是绿色的。
examples.pinyin: chūntiān shù dōu shì lǜsè de.
examples.english: In spring the trees are all green.

路上.meaning: on the road; on the way (路上小心; 路上花了两个小时)

examples.hanzi: 路上车太多，我回来晚了。
examples.pinyin: lùshang chē tài duō, wǒ huílai wǎn le.
examples.english: There was so much traffic that I came home late.

旅游.meaning: to travel; to tour; tourism (去云南旅游; 旅游景点)

examples.hanzi: 我们打算下个月去西安旅游。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen dǎsuàn xià ge yuè qù Xī'ān lǚyóu.
examples.english: We plan to travel to Xi'an next month.

examples.hanzi: 请您说慢一点儿。
examples.pinyin: qǐng nín shuō màn yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: Please speak a bit more slowly.

每.meaning: every; each (每个人; 每天早上; 每两年一次)

examples.hanzi: 每个学生都有一本新词典。
examples.pinyin: měi ge xuéshēng dōu yǒu yī běn xīn cídiǎn.
examples.english: Every student has a new dictionary.

没意思.meaning: boring; uninteresting; no fun (这个电影真没意思)

examples.hanzi: 这个电影真没意思，我看了一半就想走了。
examples.pinyin: zhège diànyǐng zhēn méi yìsi, wǒ kàn le yī bàn jiù xiǎng zǒu le.
examples.english: This movie is so boring I wanted to leave halfway through.

门.meaning: door; gate; entrance (开门, 关门; measure word 扇)

examples.hanzi: 上课的时候请关上门。
examples.pinyin: shàngkè de shíhou qǐng guān shàng mén.
examples.english: Please close the door during class.

门.meaning: measure-like use for courses/subjects: 一门课, 一门外语

examples.hanzi: 这学期我们有三门课。
examples.pinyin: zhè xuéqī wǒmen yǒu sān mén kè.
examples.english: We have three courses this semester.

门口.meaning: doorway; entrance; at the door (在门口等我)

examples.hanzi: 我在学校门口等你。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I'll wait for you at the school gate.

门票.meaning: admission ticket; entrance fee (买门票, 门票五十块)

examples.hanzi: 这个公园的门票是十块钱。
examples.pinyin: zhège gōngyuán de ménpiào shì shí kuài qián.
examples.english: Admission to this park is ten yuan.

面1.meaning: noodles (measure word 碗/份: 一碗面)

examples.hanzi: 中午我吃了一碗牛肉面。
examples.pinyin: zhōngwǔ wǒ chī le yī wǎn niúròu miàn.
examples.english: At noon I had a bowl of beef noodles.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈买了两斤面，中午包饺子。
examples.pinyin: māma mǎi le liǎng jīn miàn, zhōngwǔ bāo jiǎozi.
examples.english: Mom bought two jin of flour to make dumplings at noon.

名.meaning: name (in compounds: 姓名, 名字; 有名的)

examples.hanzi: 他在学校已经有名了，大家都认识他。
examples.pinyin: tā zài xuéxiào yǐjīng yǒu míng le, dàjiā dōu rènshi tā.
examples.english: He's already well known at school; everyone knows him.

名.meaning: for people (formal): 第一名, 三名学生, 一名医生

examples.hanzi: 我们学校来了一名新老师。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen xuéxiào lái le yī míng xīn lǎoshī.
examples.english: A new teacher has come to our school.

拿.meaning: to take; to hold; to pick up (拿一本书; 把包拿过来)

examples.hanzi: 请帮我把那本书拿过来。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ nà běn shū ná guòlái.
examples.english: Please hand me that book.

拿.meaning: to take/get (by paying or fetching): 拿行李, 拿药

examples.hanzi: 下了飞机先去拿行李。
examples.pinyin: xià le fēijī xiān qù ná xíngli.
examples.english: After getting off the plane, first go get your luggage.

examples.hanzi: 这家店的奶茶很好喝。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de nǎichá hěn hǎo hē.
examples.english: The milk tea at this shop is delicious.

examples.hanzi: 奶奶今年七十岁了，身体很好。
examples.pinyin: nǎinai jīnnián qīshí suì le, shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
examples.english: Grandma is seventy this year and in good health.

那么.meaning: so; to such a degree (今天那么忙!; 没有那么难)

examples.hanzi: 今天的作业没有那么难。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān de zuòyè méiyǒu nàme nán.
examples.english: Today's homework isn't that hard.

那么.meaning: then; in that case (那么我们明天见)

examples.hanzi: 那么我们就这么说定了。
examples.pinyin: nàme wǒmen jiù zhème shuō dìng le.
examples.english: Then it's a deal.

examples.hanzi: 那个男孩儿正在踢足球。
examples.pinyin: nà ge nánháir zhèngzài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That boy is playing soccer.

那样.meaning: like that; such (他那样的人; 为什么那样做?)

examples.hanzi: 你为什么那样看着我？
examples.pinyin: nǐ wèishénme nàyàng kàn zhe wǒ?
examples.english: Why are you looking at me like that?

鸟.meaning: bird (树上有一只鸟; measure word 只)

examples.hanzi: 树上有一只小鸟在唱歌。
examples.pinyin: shù shang yǒu yī zhī xiǎoniǎo zài chàng gē.
examples.english: There's a little bird singing in the tree.

examples.hanzi: 那个女孩儿是我妹妹的同学。
examples.pinyin: nà ge nǚháir shì wǒ mèimei de tóngxué.
examples.english: That girl is my little sister's classmate.

旁边.meaning: side; beside; nearby (学校旁边有一个公园)

examples.hanzi: 我的座位在他旁边。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de zuòwèi zài tā pángbiān.
examples.english: My seat is next to his.

跑.meaning: to run; to jog (跑得很快; 他跑到车站去了)

examples.hanzi: 他跑得太快，我跟不上。
examples.pinyin: tā pǎo de tài kuài, wǒ gēn bu shàng.
examples.english: He runs too fast; I can't keep up.

跑.meaning: to run (an errand); to go to (口语: 跑了一趟银行)

examples.hanzi: 为了办这件事，我跑了三趟银行。
examples.pinyin: wèile bàn zhè jiàn shì, wǒ pǎo le sān tàng yínháng.
examples.english: To get this taken care of, I made three trips to the bank.

跑步.meaning: to run; to jog (去公园跑步; separable 离合词: 跑了一个小时步)

examples.hanzi: 我爷爷每天早上都去公园跑步。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yéye měi tiān zǎoshang dōu qù gōngyuán pǎobù.
examples.english: My grandpa goes running in the park every morning.

票.meaning: ticket (车票, 门票; measure word 张)

examples.hanzi: 我提前买好了两张票。
examples.pinyin: wǒ tíqián mǎi hǎo le liǎng zhāng piào.
examples.english: I bought two tickets in advance.

前面.meaning: front; ahead (location: 教室前面, 车前面)

examples.hanzi: 银行就在前面，走两分钟就到。
examples.pinyin: yínháng jiù zài qiánmian, zǒu liǎng fēnzhōng jiù dào.
examples.english: The bank is just ahead — two minutes' walk.

前面.meaning: above; earlier (in a text: 前面几课)

examples.hanzi: 前面学过的生词你还记得吗？
examples.pinyin: qiánmian xué guo de shēngcí nǐ hái jìde ma?
examples.english: Do you still remember the new words we learned earlier?

起来.meaning: to get up; to rise; directional complement (七点起来; 从床上起来; 他站起来了)

examples.hanzi: 天还黑着他就起来了。
examples.pinyin: tiān hái hēi zhe tā jiù qǐlai le.
examples.english: He got up while it was still dark.

晴.meaning: clear; sunny (of weather: 今天天气很晴 / 晴天)

examples.hanzi: 今天天气很晴，我们去公园吧。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān tiānqì hěn qíng, wǒmen qù gōngyuán ba.
examples.english: It's nice and sunny today — let's go to the park.

球.meaning: ball; sphere (踢球, 打球; measure word 个)

examples.hanzi: 他把球踢进了门里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ qiú tī jìn le mén lǐ.
examples.english: He kicked the ball into the goal.

妻子.meaning: wife (measure word 位; more formal/plain than 太太, 爱人)

examples.hanzi: 他的妻子在医院工作。
examples.pinyin: tā de qīzi zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
examples.english: His wife works at the hospital.

让.meaning: to let; to allow; to make (sb do sth) (妈妈不让我去; 让他等一下)

examples.hanzi: 妈妈不让我晚上一个人出门。
examples.pinyin: māma bù ràng wǒ wǎnshang yī ge rén chūmén.
examples.english: Mom doesn't let me go out alone at night.

让.meaning: to give way; to yield (让座)

examples.hanzi: 在公交车上应该给老人让座。
examples.pinyin: zài gōngjiāochē shang yīnggāi gěi lǎorén ràng zuò.
examples.english: On the bus you should give up your seat to the elderly.

肉.meaning: meat (牛肉, 羊肉; measure word 斤/块)

examples.hanzi: 我不吃肉，请给我做鸡蛋。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bù chī ròu, qǐng gěi wǒ zuò jīdàn.
examples.english: I don't eat meat — please make me eggs instead.

商场.meaning: shopping mall; department store (measure word 个/家)

examples.hanzi: 周末商场里人特别多。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò shāngchǎng lǐ rén tèbié duō.
examples.english: The mall was especially crowded on the weekend.

上来.meaning: to come up (toward the speaker); directional complement (他从楼下上来了; 拿上来)

examples.hanzi: 他从楼下上来了。
examples.pinyin: tā cóng lóu xià shànglái le.
examples.english: He came up from downstairs.

上面.meaning: top; above; on top (书在桌子上面; 上面放着两本书)

examples.hanzi: 书在桌子上面，不在下面。
examples.pinyin: shū zài zhuōzi shàngmiàn, bù zài xiàmiàn.
examples.english: The book is on the table, not underneath it.

上面.meaning: above-mentioned; higher level (上面的意思, 上面写的内容)

examples.hanzi: 上面写的要求你都看懂了吗？
examples.pinyin: shàngmiàn xiě de yāoqiú nǐ dōu kàn dǒng le ma?
examples.english: Did you understand all the requirements written above?

上去.meaning: to go up (away from the speaker); directional complement (他上楼去了; 把东西送上去)

examples.hanzi: 他的办公室在五楼，我们上去吧。
examples.pinyin: tā de bàngōngshì zài wǔ lóu, wǒmen shàngqù ba.
examples.english: His office is on the fifth floor — let's go up.

上网.meaning: to go online; to surf the internet (用手机上网)

examples.hanzi: 妹妹每天用手机上网查东西。
examples.pinyin: mèimei měi tiān yòng shǒujī shàngwǎng chá dōngxi.
examples.english: My little sister uses her phone to look things up online every day.

生日.meaning: birthday (过生日; 生日快乐!; measure word 个)

examples.hanzi: 我生日的时候朋友们送了我很多礼物。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shēngrì de shíhou péngyoumen sòng le wǒ hěn duō lǐwù.
examples.english: My friends gave me lots of presents on my birthday.

身体.meaning: body; health (身体健康; 他身体很好)

examples.hanzi: 爷爷每天锻炼，身体很健康。
examples.pinyin: yéye měi tiān duànliàn, shēntǐ hěn jiànkāng.
examples.english: Grandpa exercises every day and is very healthy.

时.meaning: time; occasion (书面, in compounds: 小时, 有时, 此时)

examples.hanzi: 小时候我住在农村。
examples.pinyin: xiǎoshíhou wǒ zhù zài nóngcūn.
examples.english: When I was little I lived in the countryside.

事情.meaning: matter; thing; affair (一件事情; 有什么事情吗?)

examples.hanzi: 我今天有很多事情要做。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jīntiān yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào zuò.
examples.english: I have a lot of things to do today.

手.meaning: hand (洗手; measure words 只/双)

examples.hanzi: 吃饭以前要洗手。
examples.pinyin: chī fàn yǐqián yào xǐ shǒu.
examples.english: Wash your hands before eating.

examples.hanzi: 这块手表是我爸爸送我的。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shì wǒ bàba sòng wǒ de.
examples.english: This watch was a gift from my dad.

examples.hanzi: 他把书和本子都放进书包里了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ shū hé běnzi dōu fàng jìn shūbāo lǐ le.
examples.english: He put the books and notebooks into his schoolbag.

舒服.meaning: comfortable (沙发很舒服; 我有点儿不舒服)

examples.hanzi: 这个沙发坐着真舒服。
examples.pinyin: zhège shāfā zuò zhe zhēn shūfu.
examples.english: This sofa is really comfortable to sit on.

送.meaning: to give (as a present); to present (送朋友一个礼物)

examples.hanzi: 朋友送了我一本词典。
examples.pinyin: péngyou sòng le wǒ yī běn cídiǎn.
examples.english: A friend gave me a dictionary as a present.

送.meaning: to see sb off; to escort; to deliver (送我到车站; 送孩子上学; 送外卖)

examples.hanzi: 太晚了，我送你到车站吧。
examples.pinyin: tài wǎn le, wǒ sòng nǐ dào chēzhàn ba.
examples.english: It's too late — let me walk you to the station.

虽然.meaning: although; though (虽然…但是…: 虽然很累, 但是很快乐)

examples.hanzi: 虽然已经很晚了，但是他还在写作业。
examples.pinyin: suīrán yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, dànshì tā hái zài xiě zuòyè.
examples.english: Although it's already late, he's still doing homework.

所以.meaning: so; therefore; as a result (他病了, 所以没来上课)

examples.hanzi: 今天下雨了，所以运动会在下周举行。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān xià yǔ le, suǒyǐ yùndònghuì zài xià zhōu jǔxíng.
examples.english: It rained today, so the sports meet will be held next week.

疼.meaning: to hurt; painful; to ache (头很疼; 我腿疼)

examples.hanzi: 我头疼，想回家休息。
examples.pinyin: wǒ tóu téng, xiǎng huí jiā xiūxi.
examples.english: My head hurts; I want to go home and rest.

疼.meaning: to love dearly; to dote on (奶奶最疼我)

examples.hanzi: 奶奶最疼我这个孙子。
examples.pinyin: nǎinai zuì téng wǒ zhège sūnzi.
examples.english: Of all her grandchildren, Grandma dotes on me the most.

题.meaning: question (on a test); problem; exercise (这道题; 考试题; measure word 道)

examples.hanzi: 最后一道题最难。
examples.pinyin: zuì hòu yī dào tí zuì nán.
examples.english: The last question was the hardest.

踢.meaning: to kick (踢球, 踢了一下门)

examples.hanzi: 小心！别踢到椅子。
examples.pinyin: xiǎoxīn! bié tī dào yǐzi.
examples.english: Careful! Don't kick the chair.

条.meaning: for long, narrow things: 一条路, 一条裤子, 一条河, 一条狗

examples.hanzi: 我家门前有一条小河。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiā mén qián yǒu yī tiáo xiǎo hé.
examples.english: There's a small river in front of my house.

跳舞.meaning: to dance (她喜欢跳舞; separable: 跳了一个晚上的舞)

examples.hanzi: 姐姐喜欢在晚会上跳舞。
examples.pinyin: jiějie xǐhuan zài wǎnhuì shang tiàowǔ.
examples.english: My older sister loves to dance at parties.

头.meaning: head (低头, 点头; measure word 个)

examples.hanzi: 他点了点头，同意了。
examples.pinyin: tā diǎn le diǎn tóu, tóngyì le.
examples.english: He nodded and agreed.

头.meaning: first; leading (头一次, 头两名); also for some animals: 一头牛

examples.hanzi: 这是我头一次坐飞机。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ tóu yī cì zuò fēijī.
examples.english: This is my first time on a plane.

外国.meaning: foreign country; abroad (外国朋友; 去外国旅行)

examples.hanzi: 他有很多外国朋友。
examples.pinyin: tā yǒu hěn duō wàiguó péngyou.
examples.english: He has many foreign friends.

外面.meaning: outside; out (外面很冷; 他在外面等我们)

examples.hanzi: 外面下雨了，把伞带上。
examples.pinyin: wàimian xià yǔ le, bǎ sǎn dài shàng.
examples.english: It's raining outside — take an umbrella.

完.meaning: to finish; to complete (作业做完了; 吃完饭)

examples.hanzi: 写完作业他就可以看电视。
examples.pinyin: xiě wán zuòyè tā jiù kěyǐ kàn diànshì.
examples.english: Once he finishes his homework he can watch TV.

完.meaning: used up; finished; over (铅笔用完了; 水快完了)

examples.hanzi: 纸用完了，我去买新的。
examples.pinyin: zhǐ yòng wán le, wǒ qù mǎi xīn de.
examples.english: The paper is used up; I'll go buy more.

万.meaning: ten thousand (一万人, 一万块; also 'a huge number' in 万水千山 etc.)

examples.hanzi: 这个城市有八百万人。
examples.pinyin: zhège chéngshì yǒu bābǎi wàn rén.
examples.english: This city has eight million people.

忘.meaning: to forget (别忘了带伞; 我忘了他的名字)

examples.hanzi: 别忘了给奶奶打个电话。
examples.pinyin: bié wàng le gěi nǎinai dǎ ge diànhuà.
examples.english: Don't forget to call Grandma.

往.meaning: toward (direction of movement: 往前走, 往东, 往车站去)

examples.hanzi: 往前走一百米就是地铁站。
examples.pinyin: wǎng qián zǒu yī bǎi mǐ jiù shì dìtiě zhàn.
examples.english: Walk forward a hundred meters and there's the subway station.

网上.meaning: on the internet; online (网上购物, 网上查资料)

examples.hanzi: 我在网上查到了这趟车的时间。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài wǎngshang chá dào le zhè tàng chē de shíjiān.
examples.english: I found this train's schedule online.

位.meaning: polite measure word for people: 一位老师, 两位客人

examples.hanzi: 后面还有两位客人要来。
examples.pinyin: hòumian hái yǒu liǎng wèi kèrén yào lái.
examples.english: Two more guests are coming later.

为什么.meaning: why (你为什么迟到?; 这就是为什么…)

examples.hanzi: 你今天为什么迟到？
examples.pinyin: nǐ jīntiān wèishénme chídào?
examples.english: Why were you late today?

洗.meaning: to wash (洗手, 洗衣服, 洗碗)

examples.hanzi: 我帮妈妈洗了衣服。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bāng māma xǐ le yīfu.
examples.english: I helped Mom wash the clothes.

下来.meaning: to come down; directional complement (他从楼上下来了; 把书拿下来)

examples.hanzi: 他从楼上拿下来一箱书。
examples.pinyin: tā cóng lóu shang ná xiàlái yī xiāng shū.
examples.english: He brought a box of books down from upstairs.

下面.meaning: below; underneath (桌子下面, 下面这个字)

examples.hanzi: 猫在桌子下面睡觉。
examples.pinyin: māo zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn shuìjiào.
examples.english: The cat is sleeping under the table.

下面.meaning: the following; below-mentioned (下面请看第二课)

examples.hanzi: 下面我们学习第二课。
examples.pinyin: xiàmiàn wǒmen xuéxí dì èr kè.
examples.english: Next we'll study Lesson Two.

examples.hanzi: 听了这个笑话，大家都笑了。
examples.pinyin: tīng le zhège xiàohua, dàjiā dōu xiào le.
examples.english: Everyone laughed at this joke.

examples.hanzi: 她笑着打开了门。
examples.pinyin: tā xiào zhe dǎkāi le mén.
examples.english: She opened the door with a smile.

笑.meaning: to laugh at; to mock (别人笑他, 不要笑我)

examples.hanzi: 别笑我，我刚学两个月。
examples.pinyin: bié xiào wǒ, wǒ gāng xué liǎng ge yuè.
examples.english: Don't laugh at me — I've only been learning two months.

examples.hanzi: 公园里有很多小孩儿在玩儿。
examples.pinyin: gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiǎoháir zài wánr.
examples.english: There are lots of children playing in the park.

小时候.meaning: childhood; when one was little (我小时候住在农村)

examples.hanzi: 我小时候身体不好，常常生病。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎoshíhou shēntǐ bù hǎo, chángcháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: I was often sick as a child.

下去.meaning: to go down (away from speaker); directional complement, also 'carry on' (他下楼去了; 说下去!; 坚持下去)

examples.hanzi: 大家请安静，让她说下去。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā qǐng ānjìng, ràng tā shuō xiàqù.
examples.english: Everyone please be quiet and let her keep talking.

姓.meaning: to be surnamed (你姓什么? 我姓王)

examples.hanzi: 您贵姓？——我姓李。
examples.pinyin: nín guì xìng? wǒ xìng Lǐ.
examples.english: May I ask your surname? — It's Li.

姓.meaning: surname; family name (他的姓很难写)

examples.hanzi: 张这个姓的人很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng zhège xìng de rén hěn duō.
examples.english: A lot of people have the surname Zhang.

姓名.meaning: full name (surname and given name; 请写您的姓名)

examples.hanzi: 请在这里写下您的姓名和电话。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zài zhèlǐ xiě xià nín de xìngmíng hé diànhuà.
examples.english: Please write your name and phone number here.

洗手间.meaning: toilet; restroom (polite/euphemistic; 请问洗手间在哪儿?)

examples.hanzi: 请问，洗手间在哪儿？
examples.pinyin: qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?
examples.english: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

near_synonyms.difference: 想 is casual wanting (我想去); 希望 is a stronger hope/wish, often for things not fully in one's control

希望.meaning: to hope; to wish (我希望你能来)

examples.hanzi: 我希望明年能去中国留学。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xīwàng míngnián néng qù Zhōngguó liúxué.
examples.english: I hope I can go study in China next year.

examples.hanzi: 他一直没放弃自己的希望。
examples.pinyin: tā yìzhí méi fàngqì zìjǐ de xīwàng.
examples.english: He never gave up his hope.

examples.hanzi: 她的眼睛又大又漂亮。
examples.pinyin: tā de yǎnjing yòu dà yòu piàoliang.
examples.english: Her eyes are big and beautiful.

examples.hanzi: 你最喜欢什么颜色？
examples.pinyin: nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yánsè?
examples.english: What's your favorite color?

药.meaning: medicine; drug (吃药; 中药, 西药; measure word 种/片)

examples.hanzi: 医生说这种药一天吃三次。
examples.pinyin: yīshēng shuō zhè zhǒng yào yī tiān chī sān cì.
examples.english: The doctor said to take this medicine three times a day.

examples.hanzi: 他感冒了，去药店买药。
examples.pinyin: tā gǎnmào le, qù yàodiàn mǎi yào.
examples.english: He caught a cold and went to the pharmacy to buy medicine.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷每天早上都去公园走路。
examples.pinyin: yéye měi tiān zǎoshang dōu qù gōngyuán zǒulù.
examples.english: Grandpa goes walking in the park every morning.

一会儿.meaning: a moment; a little while (等一会儿; base tone yī noted: written yīhuìr, pronounced yíhuìr)

examples.hanzi: 等一会儿，我马上就好。
examples.pinyin: děng yīhuìr, wǒ mǎshàng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: Wait a moment, I'll be done right away.

已经.meaning: already (他已经走了; 已经十点了)

examples.hanzi: 他已经不是学生了。
examples.pinyin: tā yǐjīng bù shì xuéshēng le.
examples.english: He isn't a student anymore.

阴.meaning: overcast; cloudy (of weather: 今天是阴天)

examples.hanzi: 今天是阴天，可能要下雨。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān shì yīntiān, kěnéng yào xià yǔ.
examples.english: It's overcast today; it might rain.

因为.meaning: because (因为下雨, 所以我没去)

examples.hanzi: 因为生病，他今天没来上课。
examples.pinyin: yīnwèi shēngbìng, tā jīntiān méi lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Because he was sick, he didn't come to class today.

因为.meaning: because of (noun phrase: 因为你, 我们都迟到了)

examples.hanzi: 因为你，我们都迟到了。
examples.pinyin: yīnwèi nǐ, wǒmen dōu chídào le.
examples.english: Because of you, we were all late.

一起.meaning: together (base tone yī noted: 我们一起去; written yīqǐ, pronounced yìqǐ)

examples.hanzi: 周末我们一起去打球吧。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò wǒmen yīqǐ qù dǎqiú ba.
examples.english: Let's go play ball together this weekend.

意思.meaning: meaning; idea (这个词是什么意思?; 有意思 interesting, 没意思 boring)

examples.hanzi: 这个词的意思我懂了。
examples.pinyin: zhège cí de yìsi wǒ dǒng le.
examples.english: I understand the meaning of this word.

游.meaning: to swim (游得很快; 游了一小时)

examples.hanzi: 他游得比我快多了。
examples.pinyin: tā yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le.
examples.english: He swims much faster than me.

examples.hanzi: 我用右手写字。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yòng yòu shǒu xiě zì.
examples.english: I write with my right hand.

有意思.meaning: interesting; fun; amusing (这个人很有意思)

examples.hanzi: 我觉得这本书很有意思。
examples.pinyin: wǒ juéde zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: I find this book really interesting.

右边.meaning: right side; to the right (邮局在右边)

examples.hanzi: 银行的右边有一个小公园。
examples.pinyin: yínháng de yòubian yǒu yī ge xiǎo gōngyuán.
examples.english: There's a small park to the right of the bank.

有时（候）.meaning: sometimes (有时候我走路去上学; written yǒushí(hou) per the headword, read yǒu shíhou)

examples.hanzi: 有时候我走路去上学。
examples.pinyin: yǒushíhou wǒ zǒulù qù shàngxué.
examples.english: Sometimes I walk to school.

游泳.meaning: to swim (去游泳; separable: 游了两次泳)

examples.hanzi: 夏天我们最喜欢游泳。
examples.pinyin: xiàtiān wǒmen zuì xǐhuan yóuyǒng.
examples.english: In summer we love swimming most.

examples.hanzi: 这条鱼很新鲜。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo yú hěn xīnxiān.
examples.english: This fish is very fresh.

examples.hanzi: 机场离市区很远。
examples.pinyin: jīchǎng lí shìqū hěn yuǎn.
examples.english: The airport is far from the city.

运动.meaning: to work out; to do sports; sports; exercise (运动一下; 爱运动; 体育运动)

examples.hanzi: 多做运动对身体有好处。
examples.pinyin: duō zuò yùndòng duì shēntǐ yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Getting more exercise is good for your health.

运动.meaning: movement (social or political: 五四运动)

examples.hanzi: 老师在课上给我们讲了五四运动的历史。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī zài kè shang gěi wǒmen jiǎng le Wǔsì Yùndòng de lìshǐ.
examples.english: In class the teacher told us about the history of the May Fourth Movement.

站1.meaning: to stand (请站在这儿; 站了很久)

examples.hanzi: 请大家站好，我们拍张照。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dàjiā zhàn hǎo, wǒmen pāi zhāng zhào.
examples.english: Everyone please stand still and we'll take a photo.

站1.meaning: station; stop (公共汽车站, 火车站; measure word 个)

examples.hanzi: 我在下一站下车。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài xià yī zhàn xià chē.
examples.english: I'm getting off at the next stop.

examples.hanzi: 她的丈夫是一位医生。
examples.pinyin: tā de zhàngfu shì yī wèi yīshēng.
examples.english: Her husband is a doctor.

near_synonyms.difference: 在 marks an action in progress (他在看书); 着 marks an attached/ongoing state (门开着) or the manner of an action (坐着看)

着.meaning: aspect particle marking an ongoing state or attached action, neutral tone: 门开着; 他坐在那儿看电视; 拿着书

examples.hanzi: 门开着，窗户关着。
examples.pinyin: mén kāi zhe, chuānghu guān zhe.
examples.english: The door is open and the window is closed.

着.meaning: to touch; to come into contact with (着火, 睡不着 — as result complement: 睡不着, 找不着)

examples.hanzi: 他太兴奋了，晚上睡不着。
examples.pinyin: tā tài xīngfèn le, wǎnshang shuì bu zháo.
examples.english: He was so excited he couldn't sleep at night.

这么.meaning: so; this way; to this degree (这么大的雨!; 你怎么这么高兴?; 像这么写)

examples.hanzi: 你怎么这么高兴？
examples.pinyin: nǐ zěnme zhème gāoxìng?
examples.english: Why are you so happy?

正.meaning: precisely (是): 他正是我要找的人; 正在 in progress: 他正在打电话

examples.hanzi: 我到的时候，他正在打电话。
examples.pinyin: wǒ dào de shíhou, tā zhèngzài dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: When I arrived, he was right in the middle of a phone call.

正.meaning: upright; straight; main (正门, 正前方; also 'exactly at': 正十二点)

examples.hanzi: 他正好是我要找的人。
examples.pinyin: tā zhènghǎo shì wǒ yào zhǎo de rén.
examples.english: He was exactly the person I was looking for.

这样.meaning: this way; like this; such (这样做不对; 这样的人)

examples.hanzi: 这样做是不对的。
examples.pinyin: zhèyàng zuò shì bù duì de.
examples.english: Doing it this way isn't right.

examples.hanzi: 这一周工作特别忙。
examples.pinyin: zhè yī zhōu gōngzuò tèbié máng.
examples.english: Work was especially busy this week.

周.meaning: for weeks: 一周, 第一周

examples.hanzi: 再过两周就要考试了。
examples.pinyin: zài guò liǎng zhōu jiù yào kǎoshì le.
examples.english: The exam is only two weeks away.

准备.meaning: to prepare; to get ready (准备考试; 准备好了)

examples.hanzi: 我们正在准备明天的考试。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zhèngzài zhǔnbèi míngtiān de kǎoshì.
examples.english: We're preparing for tomorrow's exam.

examples.hanzi: 做这门菜要提前一天准备。
examples.pinyin: zuò zhè mén cài yào tíqián yī tiān zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Making this dish requires a day of preparation ahead.

自己.meaning: oneself; one's own (自己做饭; 我自己的房间)

examples.hanzi: 从现在起我要自己洗衣服。
examples.pinyin: cóng xiànzài qǐ wǒ yào zìjǐ xǐ yīfu.
examples.english: From now on I'll wash my own clothes.

自己.meaning: alone; by oneself (他自己在家; 自己去)

examples.hanzi: 爸爸妈妈不在家，他自己做饭。
examples.pinyin: bàba māma bù zài jiā, tā zìjǐ zuò fàn.
examples.english: Mom and Dad weren't home, so he cooked for himself.

examples.hanzi: 我们走着去吧，不远。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zǒu zhe qù ba, bù yuǎn.
examples.english: Let's walk there — it's not far.

走.meaning: to leave; to go (我先走了; 他走了三年了 — passed away, euphemism)

examples.hanzi: 不好意思，我先走了。
examples.pinyin: bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ xiān zǒu le.
examples.english: Excuse me, I have to be going.

走路.meaning: to walk; to go on foot (我每天走路去上班)

examples.hanzi: 从这里走路到学校要十五分钟。
examples.pinyin: cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù dào xuéxiào yào shíwǔ fēnzhōng.
examples.english: It's a fifteen-minute walk from here to the school.

最.meaning: most; -est (最高, 最好, 最喜欢的)

examples.hanzi: 这是我看过的最好的电影。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ kàn guo de zuì hǎo de diànyǐng.
examples.english: This is the best movie I've ever seen.

examples.hanzi: 下楼梯请靠左走。
examples.pinyin: xià lóutī qǐng kào zuǒ zǒu.
examples.english: Please keep to the left going down the stairs.

左边.meaning: left side; to the left (银行在左边)

examples.hanzi: 学校的左边有一个银行。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào de zuǒbian yǒu yī ge yínháng.
examples.english: There's a bank to the left of the school.

examples.hanzi: 他们下课后去踢足球了。
examples.pinyin: tāmen xià kè hòu qù tī zúqiú le.
examples.english: They went to play soccer after class.
